# harborpilot_provider_account (Resource)

A credential for a provider. Prefer `credential_ref` (env:NAME with an allowed prefix such as HP_SECRET_, or file:/path) in the spec; otherwise use the write-only `credential` secret.

Changes made outside Terraform are detected on refresh and shown as a diff of `spec`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "harborpilot_provider_account" "anthropic" {
  name = "anthropic-team-key"
  spec = jsonencode({
    provider_id         = harborpilot_provider.anthropic.id
    billing             = "metered_api"
    credential_ref      = "env:HP_SECRET_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" # resolved by the server
    requests_per_minute = 120
    labels              = { team = "platform" }
    enabled             = true
  })
}

# Alternatively, store the credential (write-only, Terraform 1.11+).
resource "harborpilot_provider_account" "stored" {
  name = "anthropic-stored-key"
  spec = jsonencode({
    provider_id = harborpilot_provider.anthropic.id
    billing     = "metered_api"
    enabled     = true
  })
  secrets_wo         = { credential = var.anthropic_api_key } # an ephemeral or sensitive variable
  secrets_wo_version = 1                                      # bump to rotate
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name (lowercase letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `-`).
- `spec` (String) The provider account specification as JSON, usually written with `jsonencode({...})`. See the `AccountSpec` schema in the Harbor Pilot API reference. Properties you leave out are sent as their zero value (empty string, list or map, `0`, `false`), except `enabled`, which must be set.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `secrets_wo` (Map of String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only secret values by name (`credential`). Never stored in state or plan. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later. Sent on create and whenever `secrets_wo_version` changes. Prefer secret references in the spec.
- `secrets_wo_version` (Number) Change this number to send `secrets_wo` again (for example after rotating a secret).

### Read-Only

- `drift_state` (String) `drifted` when the object was changed outside Terraform since Terraform last wrote it.
- `id` (String) Stable object id.
- `managed_by` (String) Source of the last change (`terraform` after an apply).
- `revision` (Number) Server revision, used for optimistic concurrency.
- `secret_names` (Set of String) Names of the secrets currently set on the server (stored or referenced). Values are never returned.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by id or by name.
terraform import harborpilot_provider_account.example <id-or-name>
```
